@graph.description: Enable automated deployments through natural language commands via ICA
successCriteria: Deployments can be triggered via ICA commands
Zero manual GitHub UI interaction needed

@graph.description: Make workflow triggering intuitive and fast for developers
Maintain high availability and performance of the workflow trigger service
Protect sensitive data and prevent unauthorized access
Support automated testing and building processes
successCriteria: Tests run automatically on code changes
Fast feedback on code changes (< 5 minutes)

@graph.description: Developer deploys application to production environment using ICA
preconditions: Code is committed to main branch
ICA is connected to the service
mainFlow: Developer tells ICA: 'Deploy to production'
ICA sends POST request to /trigger-workflow endpoint
Service authenticates the request using API key
Service triggers GitHub Actions workflow with production parameters
GitHub Actions workflow executes deployment steps
ICA receives success confirmation
ICA reports deployment status to developer
postconditions: Workflow run is visible on GitHub Actions page
alternativeFlows: Authentication Failure: Service rejects invalid API key, ICA reports error
Workflow Failure: GitHub workflow fails, developer checks logs and retries
Network Error: Connection timeout, system retries automatically

@graph.description: Developer runs test suite via ICA to verify code changes
preconditions: Test workflow is configured in repository
mainFlow: Developer tells ICA: 'Run tests'
ICA triggers test workflow with development environment
Tests execute on GitHub Actions
ICA monitors test execution
ICA reports test results to developer
postconditions: Tests completed successfully or with failures
alternativeFlows: Test Failure: ICA reports which tests failed with details
Timeout: Long-running tests timeout, partial results returned

@graph.description: Developer checks recent workflow runs to monitor deployments
mainFlow: Developer asks ICA: 'Show recent deployments'
ICA sends GET request to /workflow-runs endpoint
Service queries GitHub API for workflow history
Service returns formatted run history
ICA displays results with status indicators
postconditions: Developer sees list of recent workflow runs
Status of each run is clearly indicated
Links to detailed logs are provided
alternativeFlows: No Recent Runs: ICA informs no workflows have been executed recently
API Error: Service unavailable, ICA suggests retry

@graph.description: Developer builds application for staging environment testing
mainFlow: Developer tells ICA: 'Build for staging'
ICA triggers build workflow with staging parameters
Build process executes on GitHub Actions
Build artifacts are created
Staging environment is updated
ICA confirms build completion
postconditions: Staging environment is ready for testing
alternativeFlows: Build Failure: Compilation errors reported, developer fixes and retries
Resource Limit: GitHub Actions quota exceeded, build queued
